name: autofiller-desktop
description: AutoFiller AI - AI-assisted document-to-web-form desktop workflow engine
author: AutoFiller AI Team

scripts.clean: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); ['dist', 'dist-electron'].forEach(d => fs.rmSync(d, { recursive: true, force: true }));"
scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc --noEmit && vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json
scripts.build:backend: node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('child_process'); const p = process.platform === 'win32' ? '..\\backend\\venv\\Scripts\\python.exe' : 'python3'; const res = spawnSync(p, ['../backend/scripts/build_backend.py'], { stdio: 'inherit' }); process.exit(res.status || 0);"
scripts.dist: npm run build && electron-builder && npm run prune:release
scripts.dist:all: npm run build:backend && npm run dist
scripts.test: npm run build && node tests/policy_test.js && node tests/tool_registry_test.js && node tests/scanner_test.js && node tests/vault_test.js && node tests/e2e_integration_test.js
